strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: hwɛ mprempren keybox no mu hwɛ Google's revocation list (CRL) na ɛsɔ fibea ahorow pii hwɛ kosi sɛ ebenya keybox a ɛfata, a automatic backup ne Google services a wɔsan fi ase. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ tap biara so na ehia intanɛt (simma 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox fi network: twe keybox bi fi official repository (GitHub) na ɔde sie /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Ɛhia intanɛt na egye simma 1-3. Wɔde di dwuma bere a smart fetch no adi nkogu anaasɛ bere a wɔde nsa sesaa keybox no.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP nhwehwɛmu: hwɛ Remote Key Provisioning module ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ no, ɛhwehwɛ TEE adansedi adansedi krataa no mu, na ɛkyerɛ KmInstallKeybox adwinnade tebea. Nsakra biribiara — afiri tebea hwɛbea a ɛnyɛ den.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (akenkan nko ara): kyerɛ Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) a efi dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-fael a ɛwɔ hɔ, ne system properties a ɛfa ho. Ɛnsakra biribiara koraa.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP siesie: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Esiesie adansedi ho nsɛm bere a automatic pass no adi nkogu. Mmirikatu biara tintim nkonimdi/ huammɔdi nkyerɛwde a emu da hɔ.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh nyinaa. Di nsɛm a ɛyɛ den no ho dwuma na egye bere tenten. Nea afi mu aba pefee da adi wɔ awiei no.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: yi Play Store ne Google services (GMS+GSF) data fi hɔ na ɛsan boot afiri no ankasa. Sɛ wopɛ adansedi a ɛyɛ den nkutoo — ɛnka wo mfonini anaa fael ahorow da.
strings.mdCertify: • Play adansedi: hwɛ RKP abodin krataa adansedi tebea a ɛwɔ afiri no mu na ɛsan hyehyɛ adansedi agyapade no sɛ ɛho hia a. Ɛnka nea ɔde di dwuma no data.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER asiesie: asiesie Google services framework (SOTER) nsɛm a ɛfa device adansedi ho. Wɔde di dwuma ma mfiri binom a ɛde ne ho to SOTER so sen sɛ wɔde Play Integrity bedi dwuma.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies the selected fingerprint (local/advanced) and updates the pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appears in the log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: kyerɛ engine tebea a wɔde ahyɛ mu, nsateaa nkyerɛwee fael ahorow (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ne logs no. Check only — ɛnsesa biribiara.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: tu mmirika sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Fa Canary Engine a wɔayi no adi a ɛtwa toɔ no ba de hwɛ sɛ ɛne RKP adansedie nkrataa a ɛyɛ ahyɛdeɛ (February 2026) no hyia.
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: hwɛ TrickyStoreOSS tebea (pid, logs), keybox fael ahorow (active vs user), ankasa vs spoofed device nsateaa nkyerɛwee, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic a wɔde kyerɛ nkutoo.

strings.btnKbSlotsPreferSecondary: 🔁 Pɛ sɛ nea ɛto so abien

strings.hintKbSlots: Module no di keybox slots abien so: primary (kronkron, wɔmpopa da) ne secondary (backup). Saa tab yi kyerɛ slot a ɛyɛ adwuma, sesa nea wɔpɛ, anaasɛ ɛhyɛ nea ɛto so abien no ho nkuran kɔ primary so wɔ abisade a ɛda adi pefee so — a backups ne log a edi mũ ka ho.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: hwɛ TEE key import, nhomakorabea injection a ɛwɔ keystore2 mu, revocation tebea (CRL), protection-list coverage ne RKP tebea. Akenkan-nko — ɛnsesa hwee.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Wɔsan kyekye ahobammɔ list no fi app biara a wɔde ahyɛ mu.
• Wɔsan de custom-ROM compatibility layer no di dwuma.
• Wɔsan de active keybox no di dwuma.
• Google Play services no san fi ase.

Biribiara nni hɔ wɔapopa na wɔmfa wɔn nsa nka keybox titiriw no da.

Toa so?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: kyerɛ tebea a ɛwɔ primary ne secondary slots no mu na ɛsesa nea wɔpɛ wɔ wɔn ntam. Primary (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) no bɔ ho ban bere nyinaa na wɔmpopa da. Sɛ wobɛhyɛ secondary no ho nkuran akɔ primary mu a, ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wosi so dua pefee.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Promote secondary slot to primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml bɛyɛ primary slot content.
• Wɔkora mprempren primary no so sɛ backup ansa na wɔde asi ananmu.
• Wɔmpopa biribiara — adwumayɛ no yɛ reversible.

Continue?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Popa secondary slot no:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml bɛyi.
• Wɔnka primary slot no.

Toa so?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (foforo wɔ v3.17):

• Hwɛ keybox a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren no de toto Google revocation list (CRL) no ho.
• Ɛsɔ fibea ahorow pii hwɛ kosi sɛ wobehu keybox a ɛho tew.
• Automatic backup + san fi ase Google services.

⚠️ Needs intanɛt so (simma 1-3). Toa so?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Fa keybox fi intanɛt so:

• Twe official keybox no na ɛma ɛyɛ nokware.
• Wɔde ahyɛ mu daa (wɔnsan nsan da wɔ boot mu).

⚠️ Ɛhia intanɛt (ɛkɔsi simma 1). Toa so?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Re-provision RKP keys:

• Wɔmpopa data anaa keybox fael biara.
• San bɔ fon no wɔ ɛno akyi.

Toa so?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Nsiesiei a edi mũ:

• San yɛ nhyehyɛe RKP + san fi ase Google nnwuma.
• Afiri no san fi ase ankasa (wɔmpopa biribiara).

Toa so?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
San hyɛ Google nnwuma ase:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — san fi ase nkutoo.
• Wɔmpopa biribiara na RƐNNYƐ wo ho.
• Afiri no san fi ase ankasa.

Toa so?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• Wɔ mfiri a ɛbu wɔn ani gu keybox a ɛretu no so.
• Ɛyɛ adwuma mpo sɛ keys no yɛ apɔwmuden.
• Wɔmpopa data biara.

Toa so?
strings.confirmCertify:
Force Play Store adansedi:

• Popa Store cache no nkutoo — wo akontaabu no nnya nkaa.
• San bɔ, afei bue Store no.

Toa so?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• San hyɛ vendor.soter dwumadie no ase.
• Popa SOTER server data no nko ara.

Toa so?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Fa nsateaa nkyerɛwee (PIF):

• Dane custom.pif.prop na ɛde hyɛ engine kwan no mu.
• Ɛhia sɛ wɔsan bɔ bio wɔ ɛno akyi.

Toa so?
strings.confirmCanary:
Update Canary fingerprint:

• Twe Canary nsateaa nkyerɛwee a ɛyɛ aban de a aba foforo fi Google.
• Ɛma ahobammɔ patch no yɛ pɛ + ɛsan fi Google nnwuma ase (no popa).

⚠️ Ɛhia intanɛt (1-3 min). Toa so?
